title: Elmwood Reclaimed Timber: CRM moved to the cloud | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 moved Elmwood Reclaimed Timber's on-premises Dynamics 365 to the Microsoft Cloud, with Tibco (Scribe) data transfer and GP ERP order integration.
h1: On-premises CRM moved to the cloud
answer: Elmwood Reclaimed Timber, based in Peculiar, MO, supplies natural wood products to homeowners, homebuilders and architects. It wanted its on-premises Dynamics 365 system in the Microsoft Cloud. With the Microsoft Fast Track team, we migrated it, used Tibco (Scribe) for data transfer and connected its GP ERP for orders. Within 3-4 months Elmwood was using cloud-specific features.

chapters: Elmwood Reclaimed Timber, based in Peculiar, MO, is a top provider of natural wood products for homeowners, homebuilders and architects.
It wanted to migrate its existing on-premises Dynamics 365 system to the Microsoft Cloud. A former consultant coworker of Brian Begley recommended enCloud9.

With help from the Microsoft Fast Track team, we moved the CRM to the cloud. We used Tibco (Scribe) for data transfer and connected Elmwood's on-premises GP ERP for order submissions, along with Dynamics GP and ClickDimensions.
Elmwood now uses cloud-specific features such as Sales Assistance for round-robin lead assignments and sequences. The migration reduced its server room needs and streamlined its sales processes.
next_steps: Elmwood continues to work with enCloud9 to further clean up its data.
author: Kristin Caniglia
